title: Eco-engineered functionalized mesoporous silica from rice husks for selective detection of Fe(III) in aqueous media
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,28725-28742
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA02974D, Paper

By utilizing rice husk (RH) waste as a renewable source of silica, this study presents a sustainable approach for engineering eco-friendly sensors for Fe(III) detection.
